name: North Dickey Lake Campground
evidence: satellite at 48.7184,-114.8335 (rec.gov site-coord centroid; old pin was ~230 m NW on the access road): loop under closed canopy, illegible; USFS official site map (media/55970): east-side sites 15/23/25 sit in forest behind a wooded margin and the day-use beach trail, none drawn at the shore; rec.gov catalog has no Proximity to Water flags; default down

name: Sheridan Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232775 catalog: RV sites 08 and 09 (30/33 ft, north end) flagged Proximity to Water 'Riverfront'; satellite at 45.1017,-109.3076: their spur turnaround sits ~20 m from Rock Creek's braided channel (~10-15 m wide = creek); the south-end sites stay set back

name: Sage Creek Campground
evidence: satellite at 45.2137,-108.5552 (z18-ish, legible): pads along the camp spur sit ~15-23 m from small, meandering Sage Creek across open unused meadow grass (willow fringe only); several sites on the creek side of the road

name: Reservoir Lake Campground
evidence: satellite at 45.122,-113.453 (2 frames): parked RVs/pads ~40-50 m back from the south shore behind a strip of open pines; the only vehicle at the waterline is at the boat-ramp/day-use end; no site map or per-site data on the FS page; 'lakeside' prose alone cannot earn on-water

name: Willow Creek Reservoir Fishing Access Site
evidence: satellite at 47.5478,-112.4405 (3 frames): parked trailer and camp shelters on open unused grass ~10-15 m from the high-water beach band of the south shore; dam is ~1.5 km east, campground is on the lake shore not below it; FWP drawdown note does not downgrade
